terms.gloss: a deer of the smaller kinds: fallow deer, roe, gazelle
terms.comment: A general name for beasts of the deer kind (Lewis & Short); masculine in Vergil. Zoologists use dāma for the fallow deer.

phrases.latin: cervam semel vīdērunt, leporem semel, vulpem fortasse semel
phrases.english: they once saw a doe, once a hare, once perhaps a fox
Shall we see the doe today?

phrases.latin: et canibus leporem, canibus vēnābere dammās
phrases.english: with hounds you will hunt the hare, with hounds the deer

sources: Lewis & Short: damma
